scenarios.prompt: Our clinic booking backend commits a reservation and then the HTTP request times out. The agent tells the caller nothing was booked and tries again. Review this behavior and propose a guarded flow. Name the skill you used.

required.why: Treats the timeout as an uncertain outcome

forbidden.why: Must not blindly retry a write

criteria: Requires read-only reconciliation and backend idempotency
Requires completed protected read-back plus a fresh yes

examples.pass: voice-function-tools: a timeout after commit is an uncertain outcome. Reconcile with a read-only lookup, send an idempotency key, and only rebook after a read-back and a fresh yes.
examples.fail: voice-function-tools: just retry the booking call until it succeeds.

scenarios.prompt: My availability tool returns the backend's raw JSON and the agent reads it to the caller. There is no timeout on the call. What should change? Name the skill you used.

required.why: Covers silence while the tool runs

criteria: Returns a short speakable result instead of raw JSON
Says something by 1.5 s while the tool runs

examples.pass: voice-function-tools: return one spoken sentence, not raw JSON. Set a deadline on the call, and play a filler by 1.5 s while it runs.
examples.fail: voice-function-tools: keep the raw JSON and let the model figure it out.
